description: No documentation for custom hole patterns — customers sometimes need non-standard hole configurations.
customer_impact: Customers asking for custom hole styles are directed to call in, with no guidance on what's possible.

description: No torque specifications for assembly fasteners — customers unsure how tight to fasten bolts.
customer_impact: Risk of over-tightening (cracking anodize coating) or under-tightening (parts coming loose in bath).

description: No guidance on which clip style to use for specific part geometries beyond basic jaw size.
customer_impact: Customers select wrong clip type, leading to poor contact or part marking.

description: Contact wire attachment procedure not documented — only wire lengths and crimps listed.
customer_impact: New users struggle with wire installation, calling support for basic setup help.

description: No weight capacity documentation for complete assemblies — only per-disc limits listed.
customer_impact: Customers cannot calculate if their total load exceeds rack capacity without manual calculation.
